title: Recording: Uncle Albert/Admiral Halsey by Paul and Linda McCartney | 1971
content:
Studio A-1, A&R Recording, New York City
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Dixon Van Winkle

Paul and Linda McCartney worked on the song ‘Uncle Albert/Admiral Halsey’ on 1 February 1971, for the Ram album.

On this day they recorded the backing vocals for the “hands across the water” section of the song. It was then set aside until Paul was able to finish writing the lyrics for the second half of the song.
